verdict.rationale: Superset's only documented event-triggered behavior is user-defined setup/teardown scripts that run automatically when a workspace's worktree is set up or torn down, and that comes from a founder comment rather than first-party docs. Its Automations are time-based cron schedules, not event-triggered rules, so they earn no credit here, and agent-finished notifications are alerts, not user-defined actions. missing for 10: a general event→action rule engine (e.g. on PR opened, task created or agent finished, run an action), first-party documentation of event triggers, configurable conditions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: superset manages worktrees + runs setup/teardown scripts you define on project setup. Those scripts can install dependencies, transfer env variables, and spin up branching services.
